name: ai-visibility-tracker
description: AI search visibility and SEO advisor: research-first multi-site onboarding, citations, competitor rankings, keywords, trends and link opportunities, with private context, feedback, action follow-up and saved visual reviews using user-owned Apify access.

interface.longDescription: Eleven coordinated skills guide your current AI assistant from website research to useful SEO actions and follow-up reviews. Infer public business context, competitors, keywords and buyer questions; ask only for missing user-owned access, spending and consequential preferences. Select research by goals, evidence and budget rather than running every Actor. Track AEO/GEO AI citations, sampled Google rankings, traffic estimates, keyword demand, Google Trends, backlink samples and qualified link opportunities. Save accessible reports, matching-panel comparisons, private context, corrections, feedback and action history for multiple websites within one portfolio ledger. Prepare briefs and review acknowledged work without promising causal ranking gains. Reuse capable user-owned Apify MCP/connector, secure API access or an independently installed official CLI; publisher credentials are never included. Optional existing authorized first-party data can enrich analysis. Recurring collection, digests and quiet alerts require supported verified scheduling, durable state and cost controls. The skills-only package includes no server, runtime, own MCP connection or publisher telemetry. Actor usage is billable; missing data remains unknown and results are sampled.
defaultPrompt: Research my SEO and AI citation opportunities with a shared budget.
Compare my competitors’ Google rankings, traffic estimates and backlinks.
Find relevant link opportunities from competitor backlinks and AI citations.
